ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 2:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels located on the distal lobe regions to low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the medial and basal areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupy the outer lateral lobes. A central black region extends from the peduncle attachment to the median notch. Heavy black mottling, speckling, and dendritic patterns are overlaid on the white distal regions, especially near the interior margins of the white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) occur along the entire horizontal boundary, with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels from the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the distal edges tapering to acute points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity, circular white pixel groups (barnacles) are present at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Scattered white punctate spots are visible within the black medial region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four distinct, vertical, high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acorn barnacle colonization on the lateral tips and multiple vertical linear rake marks on the ventral surface of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique filigree-style black pigmentation patterns that transition from the solid black medial section into the white distal sections.
